welcome.title: Satellites cross your sky every night
welcome.body: See what’s passing over, then catch it to add its card to your collection.

location.title: Where are you watching from?
location.body: Passes depend on where you are. Your location stays on this phone, rounded to about 1 km.
location.fallback: If location is turned off, the city picker opens

catching.title: Catch one in three steps
catching.openHint: Hold your phone up to the sky

reminders.title: Want a nudge before bright passes?
reminders.body: Tap the bell on any pass and you’ll get a reminder a few minutes before it rises.
